name: Passion Fruit
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO as it's low FODMAP and the seeds provide gentle fiber that most people can handle.
preparationTips: Cut in half and scoop out pulp with seeds using a spoon
Seeds are edible and provide texture - strain if preferred smooth
Use immediately after cutting as pulp oxidizes quickly
Freeze pulp in ice cube trays for later use in smoothies
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C and antioxidants
